verses.pali: “Dasahi, bhikkhave, vaḍḍhīhi vaḍḍhamāno ariyasāvako ariyāya vaḍḍhiyā vaḍḍhati, sārādāyī ca hoti varādāyī kāyassa.
verses.english: “Mendicants, a noble disciple who grows in ten ways grows nobly, taking on what is essential and excellent in this life.

verses.pali: Khettavatthūhi vaḍḍhati, dhanadhaññena vaḍḍhati, puttadārehi vaḍḍhati, dāsakammakaraporisehi vaḍḍhati, catuppadehi vaḍḍhati, saddhāya vaḍḍhati, sīlena vaḍḍhati, sutena vaḍḍhati, cāgena vaḍḍhati, paññāya vaḍḍhati—
verses.english: He grows in fields and lands, money and grain, wives and children, in bondservants, workers, and staff, and in livestock. And he grows in faith, ethics, learning, generosity, and wisdom.

verses.pali: imehi kho, bhikkhave, dasahi vaḍḍhīhi vaḍḍhamāno ariyasāvako ariyāya vaḍḍhiyā vaḍḍhati, sārādāyī ca hoti varādāyī kāyassāti.
verses.english: A noble disciple who grows in ten ways grows nobly, taking on what is essential and excellent in this life.
Someone who grows in money and grain,
by relatives and friends, and even by royals.
When someone grows in faith and ethics,
wisdom, and both generosity and learning—
a good man such as he sees clearly,
and in this very life he grows in both ways.”
